deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: No hard import break: vllm-ascend never overrides the removed get_prefill_checkpoint_alignment/get_kv_cache_checkpoint_alignment and never calls their old signatures, so the patched upstream QwenGatedDeltaNetAttention transparently inherits the new get_cache_checkpoint_alignment() which returns self._checkpoint_alignment. Required work is to make Ascend's experimental GDN-checkpoint integration explicit against the new single source of truth: (1) In vllm_ascend/ops/gdn_checkpoint.py::initialize_gdn_checkpoints, keep setting layer._checkpoint_alignment = GDN_CHECKPOINT_ALIGNMENT (64) and confirm the layer's get_cache_checkpoint_alignment() returns it; stop depending on the removed per-layer get_kv_cache_checkpoint_alignment. (2) Explicitly set layer.requires_grid_checkpoint_alignment to False on Ascend GDN layers (per-sequence Triton exporter with max_num_seqs workspace), unless AscendStore/prefix-cache code depends on block-boundary grid offsets (old get_mamba_prefill_checkpoint_grid returned mamba_block_size), in which case set True to preserve the prior grid behavior. (3) Re-verify AscendGDNAttentionMetadataBuilder (vllm_ascend/attention/gdn_attn_builder.py) now receives raw 64 instead of the old block-size grid for self.checkpoint_alignment/self.checkpoint_builder, so checkpoint_offsets and the _ascend_checkpoint_workspace rows still line up; the kernel's chunk_size is 64, so offsets stay valid. (4) Re-check _mamba_block_aligned_split's mamba_has_prefill_checkpoint_blocks/mamba_prefill_checkpoint_alignment reads, and the Scheduler subclasses (recompute/dyntra/balance) that inherit the new LCM semantics. (5) Update tests that patch get_mamba_prefill_checkpoint_alignment or assert MambaManager.Params(prefill_checkpoint_alignment=...).
deep_analysis.risk: Medium. There is no import/attribute break, but the refactor silently changes the KV-cache checkpoint alignment used by Ascend's experimental GDN prefill checkpoints from the prefix-cache grid (mamba_block_size/prefix_match_unit) to the raw 64-token alignment, and changes the scheduler alignment from first-group to LCM. A mismatch between scheduler splits, MambaManager.Params.prefill_checkpoint_alignment, and the Ascend Triton checkpoint exporter would manifest as incorrect cached recurrent-state boundaries at prefix-cache hits (silent wrong outputs / cache miss regressions) rather than a crash, and only when gdn_internal_prefill_checkpoints and prefix caching are enabled without KV transfer.

affected_interfaces: vllm_ascend/distributed/eplb/eplb_state.py::AscendEplbState (inherits new EplbState.policy_process / stop_async_loop(timeout: float) contract; close(), start_async_loop(), drain_async(), wait_for_rearrangement(), _raise_if_async_worker_stopped())
vllm_ascend/worker/v2/eplb.py::AscendEPLBController.prepare_load (overrides upstream EPLBController.prepare_load, which now calls state.stop_async_loop() before dropping the state)
vllm_ascend/worker/v2/eplb.py::AscendEPLBController / AscendEplbState construction (StairEplbPolicy instance is now cloudpickled by upstream start_async_worker to create EplbPolicyProcess)
vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_eplb.py::_wrap_async_rebalance (calls eplb_state.policy.rebalance_experts directly and therefore bypasses the new EplbPolicyProcess)

vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_eplb.py::_wrap_async_worker (_run loop replaces upstream transfer_run_periodically/_transfer_cycle and does not honor async_worker_stop/ft_reset_epoch or EplbPolicyProcessError)

vllm_ascend/distributed/eplb/policy/stair.py::StairEplbPolicy (must be cloudpickle-serializable; current rebalance_experts calls get_eplb_group() and torch.distributed all_reduce/all_gather via plan_sharded_rebalance)
vllm_ascend/worker/worker.py::NPUWorker.shutdown (calls AscendEplbState.close(); must also terminate the new policy subprocess)
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: 1) vllm_ascend/distributed/eplb/eplb_state.py::AscendEplbState: handle the new state.policy_process attribute. Override stop_async_loop(self, timeout: float = 5) so it sets both self._stop_async (used by AscendEplbState.wait_for_rearrangement) and self.async_worker_stop, closes/reaps self.policy_process (EplbPolicyProcess.close()), then joins the thread. Make close() call this path (or explicitly policy_process.close() + clear it) idempotently after drain_async(), so NPUWorker.shutdown does not leave the child process alive. Keep drain_async() semantics because the new upstream stop_async_loop no longer drains. 2) vllm_ascend/worker/v2/eplb.py::AscendEPLBController.prepare_load: mirror the new upstream behavior; call self.state.stop_async_loop() before setting self.state=None so a second load/reload does not leak the old thread and its policy subprocess. 3) vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_eplb.py: decide explicitly whether Ascend uses the new subprocess. Either (a) keep in-process planning and prevent creating an unused child, or (b) change _wrap_async_rebalance to use eplb_state.policy_process or eplb_state.policy. If adopting (b), StairEplbPolicy.rebalance_experts must accept a single serializable EplbStats snapshot containing num_replicas/num_groups/num_nodes/num_gpus, rank_node_ids, last_committed_mean_ratios, sample counts and the old map, and must not call get_eplb_group() or torch.distributed collectives (plan_sharded_rebalance/_gather_layer_shard) inside the child. 4) vllm_ascend/distributed/eplb/policy/stair.py::StairEplbPolicy: add __getstate__/__setstate__ (or __reduce__) that drops _planner_process and _planner_connection, because a reused policy that has already started its own STAIR planner Popen/multiprocessing.Connection is not cloudpickle-able and would make EplbPolicyProcess construction raise TypeError on reload. 5) vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_eplb.py::_wrap_async_worker: update the custom _run loop to observe state.async_worker_stop and ft_reset_epoch, to propagate EplbPolicyProcessError, and to coordinate cancellation like upstream _transfer_cycle, otherwise inherited stop_async_loop may time out and leave the Ascend worker alive. 6) Add Ascend unit tests for policy-child creation/reaping on close()/prepare_load(), StairEplbPolicy serialization/reuse, and async EPLB with the STAIR policy.
deep_analysis.risk: Medium-high. Without adaptation, each NPU worker that enables async EPLB spawns an idle planner subprocess that Ascend's custom loop never uses; prepare_load/reload paths can leak it, and a reused StairEplbPolicy holding an open STAIR planner process/connection can make cloudpickle serialization fail and abort async EPLB startup. Ascend's patched _run ignores async_worker_stop/ft_reset_epoch, so the newly inherited stop_async_loop path (now called by GPUModelRunner.shutdown) can time out or leave a live worker thread. Naively routing STAIR through EplbPolicyProcess is worse: get_eplb_group() and HCCL/Gloo collectives inside plan_sharded_rebalance would run in a child process with no distributed environment, causing failures or hangs, and would bypass the explicit source-rank transfer/HIXL event-ordering logic.

Transformers backend 多模态 prompt 丢失 BOS 的修复。某些 HF processor（Emu3、Molmo2 等）在 tokenizer 编码之外会自行 prepend BOS，而 vLLM 拼接 prompt 时只保留 text tokenizer 的结果，导致与 HF expansion 不一致。新增 MultiModalProcessingInfo._prompt_prefix_ids cached_property：对空字符串与 'a' 各调用一次 HF processor，用 len(empty)-len(tokenizer('')) 得到与 tokenizer 的差值，要求 empty[split:] == tokenizer_ids 且 nonempty 的前缀一致，才认定存在公共前缀（异常时静默返回 []）；MultiModalProcessor._postprocess_prompt 在 prompt 已含该前缀时不动，否则 prepend。测试把 Emu3 从 xfail 改为正常断言，并简化为直接按原始文本调用 HF processor（不再先 tokenizer/decode 往返）。风险：探测依赖 processor 对 text-only 输入的行为与 tokenizer 空编码的关系，processor 返回异常结构时静默降级；对某些 tokenizer 会在 _postprocess_prompt 注入前缀，需确认不会被后续 tokenizer 再次重复。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。MultiModalProcessingInfo/MultiModalProcessor 的改动位于 vllm/model_executor/models/transformers/multimodal.py，属于 Transformers backend 的多模态处理路径；vllm-ascend 注册的 NPU 模型使用原生 vLLM 模型实现与多模态 processor，不经过 Transformers backend 的该 processor。

commits.comment: /v1/completions top_logprobs 字典键冲突修复。由于 CompletionLogProbs.top_logprobs 是 list[dict[str, float]]，key 是解码后的 token 文本；多个 byte-fallback token（如泰文/CJK/emoji 的字节片段）都解码为 ''，旧实现的 dict comprehension 由后出现者覆盖前者，可能把采样 token 的 logprob 覆盖成更小的候选值。serving.py 改为逐条写入并只在新 logprob 更大时替换（平局保留早出现的，采样 token 位于 islice 首位），并在 CompletionLogProbs.top_logprobs 上加文档说明。online_derenderer 的 chat→completion 转换同步改为同样的『同字符串保留最大 logprob』逻辑，保证 scale-out derender 与耦合路径一致。测试覆盖非流式/流式、采样 token rank=2 时不再覆盖，以及 scale-out 侧与新逻辑的 model_dump 相等。风险低：只影响同文本冲突时的取舍，不改变 token/logprob 的取值来源。

[Refactor][Sleep Mode] Remove unused SleepModeState and uncalled capability flags (#70038)

Signed-off-by: aoshen524 <aoshen524@gmail.com>
Co-authored-by: aoshen524 <aoshen524@gmail.com>

affected_interfaces: vllm.device_allocator.sleep_mode_backend.SleepModeBackend.state() and SleepModeState (removed base API, currently exercised by Ascend unit tests)
vllm.device_allocator.sleep_mode_backend.SleepModeBackend.__init__ / self._state (removed; CaMemBackend still writes self._state in suspend/resume/discard)

capability classmethods preserves_communicators / preserves_compiled_artifacts / preserves_graphs_with_communicators / supports_durable_storage (removed from base; CaMemBackend still overrides preserves_communicators)
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: In vllm_ascend/device_allocator/sleep_mode_backend.py, CaMemBackend still assigns self._state = "SUSPENDED"/"RESUMING"/"RUNNING" in suspend/resume/discard and overrides preserves_communicators, but after this commit the base SleepModeBackend no longer defines __init__/_state/state() nor the capability classmethods. Adaptation: (1) remove the self._state assignments (and the now-pointless super().__init__() / _state initialization) from CaMemBackend.suspend/resume/discard; (2) remove the preserves_communicators @classmethod override, which is now dead code (it was never called by upstream gpu_worker/executor even before this commit — grep shows only the definition); (3) update tests/ut/device_allocator/test_sleep_mode_backend.py to delete the three `assert backend.state() == ...` lines in test_backend_suspend_forwards_discardable, test_backend_resume_and_discard, keeping assertions on allocator.sleep/wake_up/discard. No change is needed to vllm_ascend/worker/worker.py, which only calls sleep_mode_backend.suspend/resume/discard and the still-existing SleepModeBackendFactory.is_supported/create_backend, and no production Ascend code calls state() or the removed capability flags.
deep_analysis.risk: Low. Production runtime is unaffected: NPUWorker.sleep/wake_up only use suspend/resume/discard, and the factory only uses is_supported (retained). The concrete failures are the Ascend unit tests that call the removed SleepModeBackend.state(), which will raise AttributeError until updated; leaving the stale _state writes and preserves_communicators override is harmless but should be cleaned up to avoid confusion. Also verify no out-of-tree consumer of the removed capability flags relies on CaMemBackend.preserves_communicators (e.g. future communicator-reinit logic), since it would now be a silently-dead override rather than part of the base contract.
